node.name: Containers/Dialog
node.description:
PURPOSE: A modal window that interrupts the current flow, requiring the user's attention or a decision before they can return to the page behind it.

WHEN TO USE: Destructive action confirmation, a focused task that shouldn't be dismissible by accident, collecting required information before proceeding.

WHEN NOT TO USE: Non-critical supplementary information (use Popover instead, which doesn't block the page). Anything the user should be able to easily ignore or work around (a blocking Dialog for a low-stakes decision creates unnecessary friction).

ACCESSIBILITY: Must trap focus within the dialog while open (Tab shouldn't escape to the page behind it), return focus to the triggering element on close, support Escape-to-close, and use role="dialog" with aria-modal="true" and an accessible name (aria-labelledby pointing at the Title).

COMMON MISTAKES: Not trapping focus, allowing keyboard users to Tab into the obscured page content behind the scrim. Not returning focus to the trigger element after closing.

TOKENS USED: semantic/surface/default, radius/lg, shadow-blur/5, shadow-color/5, semantic/text/primary, semantic/text/secondary, semantic/icon/muted.

PROPERTIES: Title (text), Body (text). Footer is a real composed row using actual Button instances (Cancel + Danger-style Confirm). A real "Modal (example - open)" composition alongside this component demonstrates the scrim + centered placement.

componentProperties.name: Body
componentProperties.defaultValue: A short description explaining what this dialog is asking the user to confirm or review.

unknowns.reason: Component documentation links are not captured.
Collections and explicit modes are recorded as observed; which Light/Dark, Shape or Surface modes the component is designed for is not inferred.
Nested instances record their variant selections only; text, boolean and instance-swap override values are not captured.
Whether a nested component is public, an internal helper or decorative is not determinable from Figma beyond the Icon/ naming convention.
Only the file named by the identity was read; other files (e.g. Free) and their gating are not captured.
A snapshot records what Figma contains; it is not a verdict on whether any other source matches it.
Snapshots never map Figma names to React props, CSS variables or registry fields; that is comparison work (AG-1D).
Variable bindings and their alias closure are captured, not rendered output; mode selection, fallbacks and rendered values are not evaluated.
